lines.text: Paul rejoices that the Philippians revived their concern for him, though he says he has learned to be content.
Paul says he can do all things through Christ, and that the Philippians did well to share in his affliction.
When Paul left Macedonia, no other church partnered with him, and in Corinth the Philippians provided for his needs again and again.
Paul received the Philippians' gifts from Barnabas, and he says God will supply all their needs according to His glorious riches.
All the saints send greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
